//: These settings are easier to change in-game! Mod List -> Cave Spider Spawn -> Config

Enable Cave Spider Spawn.//: Whether Cave Spider Spawn is enabled. When disabled, none of its features run and its other settings are hidden. Takes effect after a restart.

chanceSpiderIsCaveSpider.//: The chance a spider that has spawned is a cave spider. min: 0, max: 1

onlySpawnCaveSpidersBelowSurface.//: When enabled, cave spiders will only spawn below the surface.

onlySpawnCaveSpidersBelowSpecificY.//: When enabled, cave spiders will only spawn below the specific y value set in 'belowSpecificY'.

belowSpecificY.//: The specific y value used in 'onlySpawnCaveSpidersBelowSpecificY'. min: -1,000, max: 1,000

dimensionsToSpawnIn.//: Dimensions in which spiders can turn into cave spiders, separated by a comma. Leave empty for every dimension. For example: 'minecraft:overworld,minecraft:the_nether'.

biomesToSpawnIn.//: Biomes in which spiders can turn into cave spiders, separated by a comma. Biome tags work too, starting with a '#'. Leave empty for every biome. For example: 'minecraft:dripstone_caves,minecraft:lush_caves'.
